behavior.menu: Finite retention offers presets up to the saved limit; manual retention offers all presets plus all. Initial today remains unchanged.
behavior.policy_change: Refresh detects retention changes; a newly invalid selection clears the old report and fetches the longest permitted range. A failed fallback remains an error, not mislabeled old data.
behavior.aggregation: Hourly up to 30 days, daily up to 180 days, weekly thereafter, with wider integer week multiples for very long all-retained spans.
behavior.coverage: UTC year-aware from/to; unknown/deleted/precollection coverage stays unavailable. Partial periods and capped data remain marked. Quiet observed periods retain real zero metrics.
behavior.data: SQL aggregates existing hourly tables before returning chart arrays, with summed numerators/request-weighted averages; no access-log rescans, API reclassification, background worker or schema migration.
